_comment: Car-seat stroller adapter fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05. Bugaboo Donkey TWIN car-seat adapter for the Maxi-Cosi footprint; Clek's official list assigns this SKU to the Clek Liing on the Donkey (Twin) and Donkey 5 (Twin). Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Bugaboo Donkey Twin Adapter for Maxi-Cosi
seatBrandsSupported: Maxi-Cosi footprint - fits Maxi-Cosi (Mico), Nuna Pipa series, Cybex, and Bugaboo Turtle infant seats, in a side-by-side pair. Retailer pages do not name the Clek Liing, but Clek's own compatibility list designates THIS adapter (855180MC02) for the Clek Liing on the Donkey/Donkey 5 in twin mode.

status.clekNote: Clek: usable in Donkey handle positions 3-5 only; on the Donkey 2 generation max 30 lb

_statusNote: Still listed/carried by multiple US retailers (Strolleria, Bambi Baby), so treated as available; some retailers (Bambi Baby) flag it 'discontinued' as Bugaboo transitions the line to Donkey 6 adapters. Reconfirm live stock at purchase.
_priceNote: Bambi Baby lists $99.95 (marked discontinued/out of stock). Strolleria carries the Donkey Series Twin adapter but its live price was not machine-readable at check; reseller listings run ~$50-100.

install.pieces: pair (two car-seat mounts, for side-by-side twin mode)
install.notes: Tool-free click-and-go: brackets clip onto the Donkey chassis, two car seats click into the paired adapters. Clek caveat: only usable in Donkey handle positions 3-5 (Donkey 2 max 30 lb).

notes: Bugaboo part 855180MC02, the TWIN (paired) Maxi-Cosi adapter for the Bugaboo Donkey line (serves both the older Donkey/Donkey 3 in twin mode and the current Donkey 5 in twin mode per Clek's list). It carries a pair of infant seats side-by-side. Clek's definitive list pairs 855180MC02 with the twin rows (and 855190MC01 with the mono rows). Best cited price $99.95 (Bambi Baby, marked discontinued/out of stock); Strolleria still carries the Donkey Series Twin adapter. Retailer compatibility lists cite the Maxi-Cosi footprint (Maxi-Cosi/Nuna/Cybex/Bugaboo Turtle) and do not name Clek by brand; the Clek Liing shares the Maxi-Cosi footprint and Clek lists this exact SKU as the correct part.
